about: Tekken Tag Tournament (PS2) endings in Tekken 3: the T3 arena each ending plays in (the user's mapping, 2026-09-27). arena = a T3 fighter record's byte 10 (TIPS: Paul 0, Law 1, Yoshimitsu 2, Xiaoyu 3, Hwoarang 4, Lei 5, Ogre / True Ogre 6, Jin 8, Nina 9, Eddy 10, King 11, Julia / Heihachi 12, Gon 13). dark: Ogre's temple as True Ogre's fight has it (dark background: 0x800AFAA0 = 2, only the floor drawn), for the endings set in Unknown's stage. kind: engine (converted in-engine cutscene, TEKKEN3_ENDING) or fmv (a movie to convert and play in place of the stock one). done: plays in the Arcade.
